description: The plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPs and Loss Ratio for different configurations of a language model. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and has a linear scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at intervals of 1e7. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 1.  A purple line, marked “Vanilla”, begins at approximately (1e7, 97.2) and decreases to approximately (9e8, 97.1), exhibiting a generally steady decline with minor fluctuations. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, starts at approximately (1e7, 97.2) and increases to approximately (9e8, 99.3), showing a generally increasing trend. A blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, begins at approximately (1e7, 97.2) and increases to approximately (9e8, 99.2), also demonstrating a generally increasing trend. A green line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, starts at approximately (1e7, 97.2) and increases to approximately (9e8, 99.3), showing a generally increasing trend. Finally, a dark red line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, begins at approximately (1e7, 97.2) and initially decreases to approximately (5e7, 94.5) before increasing to approximately (9e8, 98.8).
